What Is Yard Waste Removal?

c: Yard waste removal is a haul-away service for organic outdoor debris that doesn’t fit municipal green bin or curbside limits — branches, brush, leaves, grass clippings, sod, garden trimmings, fallen tree limbs, and storm debris. Unlike a scheduled municipal pickup, it’s available on demand, any day of the week, for any volume from a few bags to a full property cleanup.

Live Junk Free clears yard waste the same way it clears everything else: a free on-site quote, one flat price, and same-day hauling in most cases. Spring cleanup after a long winter, fall leaf season, storm damage, or simply a backyard that’s gotten away from a homeowner — all of it gets the same straightforward process.

blocks.text: YARD WASTE REMOVAL PRICING
How Much Does Yard Waste Removal Cost?
What's Included in a Yard Waste Removal Quote?

c: Yard waste removal typically prices by volume — a few bags or a small brush pile costs less, a full property cleanup with fallen branches and years of accumulation costs more, confirmed for free at an on-site walkthrough. There’s no separate charge for organic material versus other debris, and no requirement to bag or bundle anything beforehand.
Every quote is one flat number covering loading, hauling and responsible disposal or composting. Nothing is added after the crew arrives.

items: Junk Removal + Haul-Away in One Number

blocks.text: YARD WASTE REMOVAL FAQ
Yard Waste Removal — Asked Over the Counter, Answered Straight

items.q: How much does yard waste removal cost?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at an on-site walkthrough and scales with volume — a small pile costs less, a full property cleanup costs more, all in one flat number.

items.q: Do I need to bag or bundle branches and leaves first?
a: No — the crew loads everything directly, no municipal bagging or bundling rules to follow.

items.q: Can you handle storm damage or fallen tree branches?
a: Yes, and those jobs get priority scheduling since they’re often a safety concern as much as a mess.

items.q: Is yard waste removal faster than municipal pickup?
a: Almost always. Municipal collection runs on a fixed seasonal schedule with volume limits; Live Junk Free removes any volume, any day.

items.q: What happens to the yard waste after it's removed?
a: Organic material routes to composting or green-waste facilities wherever possible, rather than general landfill.
